title: SEMLOG log record
description: JSON Lines contract for one log record emitted by SEMLOG. See STANDARDS.md section 2 for the normative prose. This document intentionally uses only a small keyword subset (type, enum, pattern, required, properties, propertyNames, dependentRequired, minimum, maximum, additionalProperties) so it can be checked by a stdlib-only in-test validator.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, UTC, microsecond precision, Z designator.

severity_text.description: Source Python level name (e.g. INFO, ERROR, or a custom level name).

severity_number.description: OTel Logs Data Model SeverityNumber, derived from the Python level via the documented mapping table.

event_name.description: Static event name matching the catalog grammar, or null for third-party free-text records.

body.description: Free-text message body for non-conformant/third-party records, or null for catalog events.

trace_id.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id, lowercase hex, not all-zero. Present only inside a bound operation.

span_id.description: W3C Trace Context span-id (parent-id of the next hop), lowercase hex, not all-zero.

trace_flags.description: W3C Trace Context trace-flags, two lowercase hex digits.

http.request.id.description: RFC 9562 UUIDv7 request id (ECS http.request.id). Present only inside a bound HTTP operation.
